hub_not_armed.title: ELRO Connects K2 hub {device_name} is not responding
hub_not_armed.description:
The hub at **{host}** never acknowledged an activation ping, so it is ignoring every command Home Assistant sends it and no devices could be created.

The usual causes are a wrong IP address or device name, UDP port 1025 being blocked or already in use, or a firewall silently dropping the hub's outbound internet traffic, which stalls the hub and stops it answering locally until that attempt times out — use a *reject* rule rather than a *drop* rule if you block it.

See the troubleshooting guide linked below, or switch on debug logging in the integration options to see every frame. This notification clears itself once the hub reports a device.

hub_no_devices.title: ELRO Connects K2 hub {device_name} reports no devices
hub_no_devices.description:
The hub at **{host}** is answering Home Assistant but listed no devices, so no entities could be created.

Either nothing is paired with this hub — check the ELRO Connects app — or a firewall is silently dropping the hub's outbound internet traffic, which stalls the hub until that attempt times out and stops it answering locally in the meantime — use a *reject* rule rather than a *drop* rule if you block it.

See the troubleshooting guide linked below, or switch on debug logging in the integration options to see every frame. This notification clears itself once the hub reports a device.

start_pairing.name: Add device
start_pairing.description: Puts the K2 gateway into pairing mode and waits for a new detector to join. Trigger the detector's pairing action (usually by holding its test button) while this is running. The detector type does not need to be selected - the gateway accepts whichever device joins.

config_entry_id.name: Gateway
config_entry_id.description: Which K2 gateway to pair with. Can be left empty when only one is set up.

timeout.name: Timeout
timeout.description: How long to keep pairing mode open while waiting for a detector to join.

cancel_pairing.name: Cancel adding device
cancel_pairing.description: Closes an open pairing window on the K2 gateway before it times out.

config_entry_id.name: Gateway
config_entry_id.description: Which K2 gateway to stop pairing on. Can be left empty when only one is set up.
